title: Applied Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
shortDescription: Industry-focused training in neural networks, computer vision, LLM integration, and real-world AI deployment pipeline.
description: Comprehensive program designed to bridge university theory with modern AI production engineering. Students work on hands-on architectures, model fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and API-driven deployment.

title: Data Science & Predictive Analytics
shortDescription: End-to-end data workflows covering exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, feature engineering, and predictive dashboards.
description: Transform data into actionable business intelligence. Learn data wrangling with pandas, automated pipelines, predictive modeling using Scikit-Learn, and executive storytelling with interactive visualization tools.

title: Modern Full Stack Cloud Application Engineering
shortDescription: Full stack architecture with modern React, Node.js, RESTful microservices, PostgreSQL, and cloud CI/CD.
description: Master the entire software product life cycle. Build robust responsive frontend interfaces, design secure REST/GraphQL APIs, manage relational databases, and deploy containerized services to cloud infrastructure.

title: Cloud Computing & DevOps Engineering
shortDescription: Cloud-native infrastructure, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), Kubernetes orchestration, and monitoring.
description: Gain the skills modern tech teams demand: scalable cloud infrastructure, container orchestration with Kubernetes, CI/CD automation pipelines, serverless architectures, and observability practices.

title: Cybersecurity & Threat Defense Essentials
shortDescription: Practical network security, vulnerability assessment, ethical penetration testing concepts, and SOC monitoring.
description: Prepare for the frontline of digital security. Learn fundamental security frameworks, network packet analysis, vulnerability scanning with industry tools, web application security (OWASP Top 10), and basic threat hunting.

title: Business Analytics & Growth Intelligence
shortDescription: Bridging business metrics, SQL analytics, financial modeling, and data-driven product growth strategies.
description: Designed for UG/PG students seeking consulting, product, and business intelligence roles. Learn metric frameworks, cohort analysis, customer lifetime value modeling, and executive dashboard communication.

title: Embedded Systems & IoT Engineering
shortDescription: Microcontroller programming, sensor telemetry, edge IoT protocols, and cloud IoT dashboard integration.
description: Connect the physical and digital worlds. Master embedded C/C++, microcontroller architecture (ESP32/ARM), MQTT/HTTP protocols, sensor integration, and industrial IoT data visualization.

title: Core Employability & Industry Professional Readiness
shortDescription: Comprehensive technical communication, technical interview mastery, portfolio architecture, and agile practices.
description: The crucial bridge that turns technical skills into hiring success. Master technical storytelling, whiteboard problem solving, clean GitHub portfolio presentation, agile sprint collaboration, and professional workplace communication.
